blocks.html: Camping and campingbar open on Thursday, 22 July at 12h.
The festival area opens on Thursday at 18h with Kortemark Congé, a free entrance festival day. The festival area closes at 1h.
On Friday the festival area opens at 17h and closes at 4h.
On Saturday the festival area opens at 12h and closes at 4h.
The camping bar at the Chilling Lion stage opens every festival day from ??h?? till ??h??. Breakfast is also served here, from 8h till we are out.
The camping closes on Sunday, 25 July at 11h.
